description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic and Arabic script (including li-ʿAbbās adāma llāhu ʿizzahu). Dating: Probably 11th or 12th century. Headed (recto left page) "the account of my master the elder Abū l-Khayr." Other names mentioned: al-Sharīf; Yehuda Ibn al-Andalusī;al-Nafūsī; Nahray (b. Nissim?); Abū l-Khayr; Abū Isḥāq; Abū Zikrī;al-Simsār; Abū l-ʿAlāʾ.
description_he: חשבונות בערבית-יהודית ובכתב ערבי. תיארוך: ככל הנראה המאה ה-11 או ה-12.
